proof.input: XTest keyboard events on the release window

release_window.workflow: Actual final ZIP extracted outside checkout, ELF launched with PATH=/usr/bin:/bin. XTest keyboard events: begin, movement/blade/seal/dodge, pause, tactics, resume, actual idle defeat, restart. Exact raw1280x800 root framebuffer captures reviewed. Release process was terminated only for test cleanup.
release_window.boundary: The release template lacks --script. It was not claimed to run test scripts or a full scripted victory. Exact released PCK ran those under the editor; direct ELF window proved actual runtime play with OS input.

verified.producer_failure: A copied project with a real broken GDScript import returned engine output errors. Producer detected them despite Godot zero exit and wrote no invalid-output.zip; maintained sources remained intact.

reasoned_assessment.reviewer: Implementing Codex agent, not independent humans.
reasoned_assessment.assessment: A ready-to-run Linux player removes an editor-install barrier. Analog/digital pad input and current hints support a conventional desktop flow without changing combat incentives. Source/controller and actual release frames are readable; full hardware/usability and commercial evaluation remain separate.
refinements: Rejected direct --script use on the release template; separated resource tests and actual executable-window verification.
Kept controller state separate from keyboard; inactive-pad disconnection now clears it without pausing an active keyboard player.
Caught real script import errors instead of trusting Godot zero exit; excluded test tools, source caches and unneeded masters from the player.
